global.description: Global runtime settings for the FTP proxy

port.description: Port on which the FTP proxy listens for client connections

interface.description: IP address interface to bind the proxy to

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (debug, info, warn, error)

backend.description: Authentication method: 'file' for local DB file or 'ldap' for directory service

userdb.description: Path to the user database file (used only when backend=file)

uri.description: LDAP server URI (e.g., ldap://host or ldaps://host)

base.description: LDAP base DN for user lookups

bind_dn.description: DN used to bind to the LDAP server

bind_password.description: Password for LDAP bind (leave empty if using SASL or keytab)

user_filter.description: LDAP filter to locate user entries; '%u' replaced by username

limits.description: Resource and connection limits to prevent abuse

max_connections_per_ip.description: Maximum concurrent connections per client IP

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before idle connections are closed

transfer_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity during data transfer before aborting

upstream.description: List of upstream FTP servers to proxy requests to

servers.description: Upstream servers; each entry defines a target FTP server

name.description: Unique identifier for this upstream server

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the upstream FTP server

port.description: Port of the upstream FTP server

use_tls.description: Enable explicit FTP over TLS (FTPS) when connecting to this upstream

file.description: Path to log file; ignored if syslog is enabled

syslog.description: Send logs to system syslog instead of a dedicated log file
